subject: Air freight quote to RUH
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option to RUH (Riyadh, SA)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 45806 (Essen), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include this in the all-in price in EUR.

The shipment is 1 piece of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 3344.42 lb and a volume of 295.24 cubic feet.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a shipment to Riyadh.
